- Passing triangles - Set up triangles around the field and have players pass the ball around the triangle. Start with 2 touch passes and then progress to 1 touch. 

- Control and turn - Have players receive a pass, control the ball, and then quickly turn or change direction. Add defenders to increase difficulty.

- Juggling - Have players juggle the ball using different parts of their foot to improve touch. You can turn this into a competition.

- Box passing - Set up a 10x10 yard box and have 4-5 players pass the ball within the box. Encourage quick, accurate passing.

- Pass and follow - Players pass the ball then sprint to follow their pass and receive a return pass. Focus on passing accuracy and weight. 

- Dribbling obstacle courses - Set up cones, poles or mannequins that players must dribble through and around.
